name: Cowabunga Jellyfin Companion
description: Media recognition, localized metadata and Cowabunga artwork with per-library controls.
overview: Smart Resolver, Choose your Meta and Custom Artwork in one plugin.

versions.changelog: Search movies in Russian and English, then localize matches by exact TMDB ID. Honor the supplied year and direct TMDB ID in manual search.
Hide disabled Language Artwork from item image search while preserving library provider discovery. Add Companion settings to the dashboard sidebar.
Restore Russian manual movie/series search for pathless Jellyfin requests. Apply Russian movie overview and tagline after identification while respecting localization settings and metadata locks.
Show cloud artwork candidates in media-folder storage mode. Keep library restrictions and existing background file-write safeguards.
Fix missing image providers in Jellyfin library settings. Keep module and library restrictions when fetching images; clarify automatic library configuration and media-folder storage.
Fix collection poster and logo language preferences being overridden by Jellyfin metadata-language sorting. Fall back per image type only when preferred-language artwork is unavailable.
Unified modules, library scopes and coordinated artwork updates for Jellyfin 12.

description: Safely finds media stored in extra folders and reads movie names from video files.
overview: Finds series stored one folder deeper and reads movie names from video files.
name: Jellyfin Smart Resolver

versions.changelog: Enable reliable automatic updates from the Jellyfin plugin repository.

overview: Controls RU/EN metadata and artwork without requiring a separate TMDB key.
name: Choose your Meta!
description: Choose Russian or English metadata, posters, and logos for movies and collections.

versions.changelog: Identify collections from linked movies and safely identify movies and series. Exact IMDb mappings correct stale TMDB IDs; ambiguous title/year searches are skipped instead of selecting the first result.

overview: Custom artwork from a private Cowabunga cloud.
name: Cowabunga Custom Artwork
description: Provides custom posters and logos for movies, series, seasons and collections.

versions.changelog: Локальные poster/folder/cover/default и clearlogo/logo корректно заменяются только по явной настройке; неприменённые изображения коллекций гарантированно ставятся на refresh; изменения индекса подтверждаются после постановки обновлений в очередь.
